settings.heading: New, open box or as-is?
settings.text: Here's exactly what each label means.

settings.heading: Know what you're getting.
settings.text: Every product shows its condition. Here's what each label means. The photos and description always cover the details of that exact item.

settings.label: New
settings.tip: The photos for anything shown in the description.

settings.label: Like new
settings.definition: Looks and works like new. It may have been opened or returned.
settings.tip: The photos for packaging and any missing accessories.

settings.label: Open box
settings.definition: The packaging has been opened. It may have been returned or used for display.
settings.tip: The description for what's included in the box.

settings.label: Used
settings.definition: Previously used. Expect normal signs of wear.
settings.tip: The photos up close for scuffs or marks.

settings.label: As is
settings.definition: Sold as-is, exactly as you see it.
settings.tip: Everything. Read the description and come see it in person if you're unsure.

settings.heading: Condition questions
settings.empty_text: No questions match that. Try another word, or send us a message.
settings.cta_text: Come see the store in person, or send us a message.

settings.question: What do the condition labels mean?
settings.answer: Every product shows its condition, like New, Open box or As is. See the condition guide for what each one means. The photos and description always cover the details of that exact item.

settings.question: What does "as-is" mean?
settings.answer: The item is sold exactly as you see it. Look closely at the photos and description, and come see it in person if you're unsure.
